rationale: C09 is a clear drafting template for the child. Both memoranda announce the annual United Givers Fund campaign in the National Capital Area, describe the same local geographic coverage and participating agencies, identify a cabinet official as Chairman of the Government Unit, and close by predicting that Government personnel will join him in making the campaign an outstanding success. The child updates the campaign from the third to the fourth year, revises beneficiary counts and examples, and substitutes the 1959 chairman. C13 and C07 are closely related earlier iterations, but C09 is textually and structurally nearest.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This fall, the United Givers Fund of the National Capital Area will conduct its fourth annual campaign among us.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United Givers fund will hold its third annual campaign in the National Capital Area this fall.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely recasts the campaign announcement while incrementing the annual campaign number.

shared_material.child_excerpt: nearly 150 local and national agencies which provide health and welfare services to the people of Washington and nearby Maryland and Virginia
shared_material.parent_excerpt: scores of local agencies serving almost 500,000 people yearly in Washington and nearby Maryland and Virginia
shared_material.explanation: Both describe the fund through its health-and-welfare beneficiaries and use the same distinctive three-jurisdiction geographic formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Among its many participating agencies are the American National Red Cross and its six metropolitan area chapters, the United Service Organizations (USO)
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The campaign also includes the six metropolitan area chapters of the American National Red Cross, the USO
shared_material.explanation: The same prominent participating organizations appear in substantially parallel language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Honorable Neil H. McElroy, Secretary of Defense, has accepted the task of serving as Chairman of the Government Unit for the 1959 United Givers Fund Campaign.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Honorable William P. Rogers, Attorney General of the United States, has kindly consented to act as Chairman of the Government Unit for the 1958 United Givers fund Campaign.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the office-and-appointment sentence machinery while updating the chairman and year.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I know his fellow workers in Government will want to join in making this campaign an outstanding success.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I know all Government personnel will want to join with him in making this community-wide fund-raising effort an outstanding success.
shared_material.explanation: The closing appeal is a close verbal adaptation of C09's concluding sentence.
